_comment: Hand-curated sample matching the exact response shape of GET /api/top-rated. Thirteen canonical AAVs, eight top producers each, with up to three top varietals (1-5 star scale) and up to three top vintages (100-point critic scale). Use this as the reference payload while the live seed (scripts/seed_top_rated.py) is offline.

top_wineries.name: Krug
top_wineries.note: Multi-vintage Grande Cuvee is the benchmark for prestige NV Champagne.

top_varietals.note: House style: oxidative, oak-aged reserve wines layered for depth.
Single-vineyard Chardonnay from a 1.85 ha walled plot.
Pinot-Noir-led rose assembled like Grande Cuvee.

top_vintages.note: Laser-cut acidity, decades of life ahead.
Steely, aging on its acid spine.

top_wineries.name: Salon
top_wineries.note: Vintage-only Blanc de Blancs from Le Mesnil-sur-Oger.

top_varietals.note: Released only in declared years; long pre-disgorgement aging.

top_vintages.note: Tense, mineral, built to age 30+ years.

top_varietals.note: Entry into the Selosse style; oxidative, gastronomic.

top_wineries.note: Cristal is the defining prestige cuvee of modern Champagne.

top_varietals.note: Saignee method; only made in great years.

top_wineries.note: Pinot-driven house; barrel-fermented reserves and long lees aging.

top_vintages.note: La Grande Annee at peak form.
